sources.title: DavidAU/Qwen3.8-27B-Cold-Fusion-GAIN-V1.1-NM-DAU-NEO-MAX-MTP-GGUF
sources.snippet: Post-trained Qwen3.8-27B variant using the COLD FUSION (GAIN+Unsloth) tuning to reduce internal reasoning-token use and improve instruction following while keeping base capabilities. Deliverables include 256k-context-compatible GGUF quants (regular and MTP, NEO IMATRIX), vision support via an mmproj, and three reasoning-effort modes (xhigh/medium/low).
